title: Municipal Trade License Registration & Silpasathi Portal Compliance in WB
summary: Essential guidance for obtaining and renewing Certificates of Enlistment via the Silpasathi portal and Udyam registration across Baidyabati, Serampore, and Kolkata.
body:
Every commercial establishment operating within West Bengal municipal jurisdictions must hold a valid Certificate of Enlistment (Trade License) under the West Bengal Municipal Act, 1993, applied through the Silpasathi Single Window Portal.

Required Statutory Documentation:
• Proof of occupancy (Rent Agreement, Municipal Tax Receipt, or Possession Letter).
• Fire safety NOC (for industrial and commercial units).
• Udyam MSME Registration Certificate.
• Annual Professional Tax Challan via GRIPS portal.

Ensure renewal filings are executed before municipal cutoffs to prevent sealings and penalties. Visit our physical desk at [Baidyabati Municipal Chamber Desk](/locations/baidyabati-sheoraphuli) for expedited processing.
